fact: 1918年9月下旬，奥斯曼军队在巴勒斯坦—叙利亚战线崩溃，9月底放弃大马士革；英军先抵达该城，但奉命让费萨尔先入城以「解放者」身份进城。此后奥斯曼在叙利亚的统治迅速瓦解。

sources.title: Ottoman Empire/Middle East, 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War
sources.quote: Thomas Edward Lawrence (1888-1918), one of a number of Entente personnel working with the rebel forces, convinced Prince Faysal to coordinate his attacks on the Ottomans with the British strategy in Palestine. The Ottomans abandoned Damascus at the end of September 1918. Although Allenby's forces reached the city first, they were ordered to allow Faysal to enter ahead of them as “liberator”.

fact: 1918年10月30日，奥斯曼帝国与代表协约国的英国在爱琴海利姆诺斯岛的马德罗斯港签署停战协定，标志着奥斯曼在第一次世界大战中的战败。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Armistice of Mudros
sources.quote: Armistice of Mudros, (Oct. 30, 1918), pact signed at the port of Mudros, on the Aegean island of Lemnos, between the Ottoman Empire and Great Britain (representing the Allied powers) marking the defeat of the Ottoman Empire in World War I (1914–18).

fact: 《马德罗斯停战协定》的条款包括：奥斯曼交出在汉志、也门、叙利亚、美索不达米亚、的黎波里塔尼亚与昔兰尼加的剩余驻军；协约国占领达达尼尔与博斯普鲁斯海峡、巴统以及托罗斯隧道系统；协约国取得「在秩序混乱时」占领安纳托利亚六个亚美尼亚省份、并在其安全受威胁时夺取「任何战略要点」的权利；奥斯曼军队复员，土耳其港口、铁路与其他战略要点对协约国开放使用。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Armistice of Mudros
sources.quote: Under the terms of the armistice, the Ottomans surrendered their remaining garrisons in Hejaz, Yemen, Syria, Mesopotamia, Tripolitania, and Cyrenaica; the Allies were to occupy the Straits of the Dardanelles and the Bosporus, Batum (now in southwest Georgia), and the Taurus tunnel system; and the Allies won the right to occupy “in case of disorder” the six Armenian provinces in Anatolia and to seize “any strategic points” in case of a threat to Allied security. The Ottoman army was demobilized, and Turkish ports, railways, and other strategic points were made available for use by the Allies.

fact: 1918年11月13日，协约国对君士坦丁堡的事实占领开始：11月7日协约国舰队以「扫雷」为名通过达达尼尔海峡，61艘军舰锚泊于首都外海（加上后续舰只共73艘）；11月12日法军先入城，13日英军登陆，共3,626名士兵（以英军为主）分驻城内；佩拉与鲁梅利亚海岸归英国管制，法提赫区归法国，安纳托利亚一侧归意大利。至11月15日，锚泊舰只增至167艘。

sources.title: United Kingdom during the Turkish War of Independence, Wikiwand
sources.quote: The de facto occupation of Constantinople commenced on 13 November 1918. On 7 November, under the pretext of clearing mines, the Allies' navy passed through the Dardanelles and reached the city. The Allies' navy, consisting of 61 warships, anchored in front of the capital. ... 3,626 soldiers, the majority British from the Allied Fleet, landed. ... Beyoğlu/Pera and the Rumelian coast were left under the control of the British, the Fatih district under the control of the French, and the Anatolian coast under the control of the Italians. ... The number of ships anchored in front of Constantinople increased to 167 by 15 November.

sources.title: Occupation of Constantinople（英文维基百科条目镜像）
sources.quote: The first French troops entered the city on 12 November 1918, followed by British troops the next day.

fact: 1914至1918年奥斯曼帝国生活成本上涨约18倍（同期英国与法国约翻倍、德国近三倍）；伊斯坦布尔马铃薯每奥卡（约1.2公斤）由1914年7月的1库鲁什涨至1918年1月的36库鲁什，大米由每奥卡3库鲁什涨至95库鲁什。到1916年小麦产量已下降30%。

sources.title: Ottoman Empire/Middle East, 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War
sources.quote: During the war years (1914-1918), the cost-of-living rose by a factor of eighteen. In comparison, in Britain and France the cost of living doubled and in Germany almost tripled. In Istanbul, the price of potatoes (one okka, roughly 1.2 kg) went from 1 kuruş in July 1914 to 36 kuruş in January 1918. During the same period, the price of rice increased from 3 kuruş per okka to 95 kuruş. ... By 1916 wheat production had fallen by 30 percent.

fact: 伊斯坦布尔面包的年度平均零售价（库鲁什／奥卡）：自由市场1914年1.25、1916年9.5、1917年18、1918年34、1919年13；政府定价（配给）1916年1.6、1917年2.5、1918年2.5。即1918年自由市场面包价约为1914年的27倍，而配给价被压在2.5库鲁什。

fact: 1914年战争爆发时，奥斯曼帝国已背负1.4亿英镑外债，经济以农业为主，是交战各国中工业化程度最低的；战争在伊斯坦布尔市场引发恐慌并打乱财政，导致债务偿付延期、开征特别战争税（tekalif-i harbiye）与征用、以及文武官员薪俸的大幅削减。

sources.title: Ottoman Empire/Middle East, 1914-1918-online
sources.quote: When the war broke out in 1914, the Ottoman Empire already suffered from an external debt of 140 million pounds. It also had a predominantly agrarian economy and was perhaps the least industrialized of the belligerent countries. ... The war's outbreak created a panic in the Istanbul market and disrupted government finance, resulting in the postponement of debt payments, the implementation of special war taxes (tekalif-i harbiye) and requisitions, and a significant reduction in salaries for civil and military officials.

fact: 1913年奥斯曼工业普查显示，在后来成为现代土耳其的疆域内，仅有600家雇工10人以上的制造企业；制造业以手工业为主，严重依赖进口制成品。战时俄海军轰炸黑海沿岸煤厂并拦截运输船，帝国须从德国进口煤，数量不足，南部安纳托利亚与叙利亚遂改用木柴作燃料，以致砍伐果树与橄榄树。

sources.title: Ottoman Empire/Middle East, 1914-1918-online
sources.quote: The 1913 Ottoman Industrial Census showed that within the borders of what became modern Turkey, there were only 600 manufacturing establishments with ten or more workers. Manufacturing was largely based on artisanal forms and the empire was heavily dependent on imports of manufactured goods ... The Ottomans now had to import coal from Germany in order to run their trains. The imports were insufficient and so Ottomans turned to wood as fuel, especially in southern Anatolia and Syria. This meant that fruit or olive trees, which provided food and livelihood for people, were cut down.

fact: 战时伊斯坦布尔的统一与进步委员会（CUP）政权为稀缺商品的进口与分销设立垄断，并把垄断权与铁路车皮、航运许可优先授予与党有联系的穆斯林—土耳其商人；这套做法是「民族经济」（Milli İktisat）政策的支柱，目标是扶植一个民族主义的穆斯林—土耳其资产阶级。

sources.title: Ottoman Empire/Middle East, 1914-1918-online
sources.quote: In Istanbul, CUP policies also undercut the food supply. Party bosses created monopolies for importing and distributing scarce commodities. These monopolies and privileged access to railcar space and shipping permits were then granted primarily to Muslim-Turkish merchants and entrepreneurs who had close connections to the party. Milli İktisat (National Economics) was a pillar of the nationalist effort to create a national Muslim-Turkish bourgeoisie.
